policy: An entry is only digitised when a verifiable primary source can be transcribed offline. Where the source document is not held in the worktree the family is recorded here as WITHHELD instead of fabricating numbers (honest-FAIL discipline).

families.family: Abramson (1966) / Faltinsen (2000) resonant free-surface amplitude and impact-pressure tables
families.reason: The nonlinear resonant amplitude and sloshing impact pressure tables are read off figures in NASA SP-106 / Faltinsen ch.8; no scan is held in-repo and figure read-off would be a MEASURED-provenance claim we cannot support offline.

families.family: Riska / FSICR (Finnish-Swedish Ice Class Rules) ice-load coefficients
families.reason: Rule tables are distributed as rulebook PDFs; the c1..c4/p0 coefficient set differs between FSICR 2008/2010/2017 revisions. Transcribing them from memory would risk a silent revision mismatch, so they are deferred until the rulebook is archived in-repo.

families.family: Kerr (1964) two-parameter *viscoelastic* foundation creep compliance tables
families.reason: Only the elastic two-parameter (Pasternak) peak-deflection factor is digitised (kerr1964.pasternak_peak_factor); the viscoelastic tables require material constants not available offline.
